cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: You Handle the Evidence
cards.instruction: Make someone else take responsibility for the evidence, loose end, or difficult follow-up.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. Will you explain my missing magician's receipt to the treasurer? You booked him.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You paid him. I only found his number.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. Then ring him for a replacement. You've got the number.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: He won't send a duplicate unless the treasurer emails him directly.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then draft her email and get her to send it. Copy yourself in so you can chase him.

mechanism: A treats corrections as grounds for new assignments until B owns the missing receipt's entire follow-up.
confusable: Unlike a factual inquiry, A keeps transferring the task even when B corrects A's account of responsibility.
comparison: Contacting a magician and treasurer differs from physical cashbox custody.
seedUse: The seed's successive ring, draft and chase commands already combine S01 rank with D125 offloading.
